description.en: Our own star — the roaring nuclear furnace that lights our days, drives our weather, and makes life on Earth possible.
description.hr: Nasa vlastita zvijezda — bucna nuklearna pec koja obasjava nase dane, pokrece vrijeme i cini zivot na Zemlji mogucim.

back.en: A star — a giant ball of hot plasma. It only looks special because it's the closest star to us.
back.hr: Zvijezda — ogromna kugla vruce plazme. Izgleda posebno samo zato sto nam je najbliza zvijezda.

front.en: How hot is the Sun's core?

back.en: About 15 million °C. The surface is 'only' around 5,500 °C — cooler, but still enough to vaporize anything we know.
back.hr: Oko 15 miliona °C. Povrsina je 'samo' oko 5.500 °C — hladnija, ali dovoljna da ispari sve sto poznajemo.

back.en: The process powering the Sun: hydrogen nuclei fuse into helium, releasing enormous energy. It's why the Sun shines.
back.hr: Proces koji pokrece Sunce: jezgre vodika se spajaju u helij, oslobadjajuci ogromnu energiju. Zato Sunce sija.

front.en: How much of the Solar System's mass is the Sun?
front.hr: Koliki dio mase Suncevog sistema cini Sunce?

back.en: About 99.8%. Everything else — all planets, moons, asteroids — shares the leftover 0.2%.
back.hr: Oko 99,8%. Sve ostalo — sve planete, mjeseci, asteroidi — dijeli preostalih 0,2%.

front.en: How long does light take to leave the Sun's core?
front.hr: Koliko svjetlosti treba da napusti jezgro Sunca?

back.en: Up to 100,000 years to reach the surface, bouncing around inside — then just 8 minutes to reach Earth.
back.hr: I do 100.000 godina da dodje do povrsine, odbijajuci se unutra — pa onda samo 8 minuta do Zemlje.

back.en: A sudden burst of energy from the Sun's surface. Strong ones can disrupt satellites, radio and power grids on Earth.
back.hr: Nagli izljev energije s povrsine Sunca. Jaki mogu poremetiti satelite, radio i elektromreze na Zemlji.

front.en: What color is the Sun really?

back.en: White. It emits all colors together. Our atmosphere scatters blue light away, making it look yellow from the ground.
back.hr: Bijelo. Emituje sve boje zajedno. Nasa atmosfera rasprsuje plavu svjetlost, pa nam izgleda zuto s tla.

back.en: Cooler, darker patches on the Sun's surface caused by magnetic activity. Some are larger than the entire Earth.
back.hr: Hladnije, tamnije mrlje na povrsini Sunca uzrokovane magnetskom aktivnoscu. Neke su vece od cijele Zemlje.

front.en: How long will the Sun keep shining?

back.en: About another 5 billion years. Then it will swell into a red giant and eventually shed its layers, leaving a white dwarf.
back.hr: Jos oko 5 milijardi godina. Onda ce nabujati u crvenog diva i naposljetku odbaciti slojeve, ostavljajuci bijelog patuljka.

front.en: How many Earths would fit across the Sun?
front.hr: Koliko bi Zemalja stalo preko Sunca?

back.en: About 109 Earths in a row would span its diameter. It's the biggest thing in our sky by far.
back.hr: Oko 109 Zemalja u nizu prekrilo bi njegov promjer. Daleko najveca stvar na nasem nebu.

back.en: A constant stream of charged particles flowing from the Sun across the Solar System. It shapes comet tails and sparks auroras.
back.hr: Stalni tok nabijenih cestica koji struji sa Sunca kroz Suncev sistem. Oblikuje repove kometa i pali polarnu svjetlost.

front.en: How long does the Sun take to rotate?
front.hr: Koliko Suncu treba da se okrene?

back.en: It's not solid, so it spins unevenly — about 25 days at its equator but 35 near its poles.
back.hr: Nije cvrsto, pa se vrti neravnomjerno — oko 25 dana na ekvatoru, ali 35 blizu polova.

front.en: Why should you never look directly at the Sun?
front.hr: Zasto nikad ne treba gledati direktno u Sunce?

back.en: Its light can permanently damage your retina within seconds — even during a partial eclipse. Always use proper solar filters.
back.hr: Njegova svjetlost moze trajno ostetiti mreznicu za nekoliko sekundi — cak i tokom djelimicnog pomracenja. Uvijek koristi prave solarne filtere.
